Motivation· To develop a sequential replacement strategy for mandibular defects using 3D-printed plastic and titanium implants.
Method· Sheep mandibular defects were created via piezosurgery and sequentially replaced with FDM plastic and SLS titanium implants based on preoperative digital design.
Result· Histological analysis revealed signs of osteointegration and fibro-osseointegration in the preimplantation zone.
Validation· Validation was performed through an in vivo sheep model with tissue sampling and analysis.

Motivation· To compare biological responses of micro-/nano-tubes and micro-/nano-nets on selective laser melting titanium surfaces for improved osseointegration.
Method· TNTs and TNNs were fabricated on SLM titanium; surface characterization, in vitro MC3T3-E1 and RAW 264.7 assays, and in vivo Beagle dog implantation were performed.
Result· TNTs showed higher osteogenic activity while TNNs exhibited stronger inhibition of osteoclastogenesis.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo micro-CT and histological analysis.

单位: Perm National Research Polytechnic University, Perm, Russia
通讯: Полина Килина @ Perm National Research Polytechnic University, Perm, Russia  |  Л. Д. Сиротенко @ Perm National Research Polytechnic University, Perm, Russia  |  Е. В. Матыгуллина @ Perm National Research Polytechnic University, Perm, Russia
相关性: 该论文研究通过选区激光熔化制造具有特定力学性能的多孔结构，可用于生物医用植入物的刚度匹配，但未涉及疲劳和骨整合。
边界: This paper does not explicitly link porous structures to stress shielding, does not report fatigue testing, and lacks surface roughness or osseointegration assessment.
动机· 通过实验和几何建模，制造具有指定力学性能的钛合金多孔结构。
方法· 基于熔融条带实验和几何建模，调控SLM工艺参数，制备多孔Ti6Al4V样品。
结果· 获得了均匀表面、低几何偏差的稳定样品，实现了孔隙率、抗压强度和弹性模量的可控。
验证· 通过熔融实验和几何建模进行验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To fabricate cellular structures with tailored mechanical properties (porosity, compressive strength, elastic modulus) for potential biomedical applications via selective laser melting.
Method· Experimental melting of strip-like crosspieces combined with geometric modeling was used to determine stable processing conditions and design cellular Ti6Al4V structures.
Result· Stable samples with uniform surface structure and minimal geometric deviation were produced, achieving specified macroscopic porosity, compressive strength, and elastic modulus.
Validation· The approach was validated experimentally by comparing as-built geometry and mechanical properties (compressive strength, elastic modulus) to the geometric model.

Motivation· To investigate how geometric parameters of TPMS structures affect their mechanical properties for potential multifunctional applications.
Method· Selective laser melting (SLM) fabricated Neovious, Schoen I-WP, and Schwarz Primitive structures, combined with Taguchi method to analyze the effects of wall thickness, cell count, and unit cell length on elastic modulus and compressive strength.

Motivation· To address insufficient osseointegration of prostheses in osteoporotic bone by developing a functional drug-releasing interface.
Method· A composite interface was fabricated by combining 3D-printed porous titanium alloy with poloxamer 407 hydrogel loaded with 99Tc-MDP.
Result· The drug-loaded interface enhanced osteogenic differentiation, inhibited osteoclastogenesis, and achieved stable osseointegration in an osteoporotic rabbit model.
Validation· In vitro cell assays and in vivo implantation in a rabbit distal femoral defect model.

相关性: 该方法可迁移用于生物力学中线性偏微分方程的格林函数学习，但未涉及植入物设计的约束处理与不确定性量化。

动机· 让深度学习以人类可理解的方式揭示物理规律。

Motivation· To enable deep learning to reveal physical laws in a human-interpretable manner by discovering Green's functions from data.
Method· Rational neural networks are trained on system responses under Gaussian process excitations to learn Green's functions of hidden linear partial differential equations.
Result· The approach successfully extracts interpretable features such as conservation laws, symmetries, and boundary effects from several benchmark physics problems.
Validation· Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks including advection-diffusion, viscous shocks, and Stokes flow in a lid-driven cavity.

A Prospective, Randomized Comparison of the Long-Term Clinical and Radiographic Results of an Ultra-Short vs a Conventional Length Cementless Anatomic Femoral Stem.

Low Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Peripheral Background only clinical Exp. validation
Young-Hoo Kim, Young-Soo Jang, Eun-Jung Kim The Journal of arthroplasty 2021-05-01 10.1016/j.arth.2020.12.030
单位: The Joint Replacement Center of Seoul Metropolitan Seonam Hospital, Seoul, Republic of Korea.
通讯: Eun-Jung Kim @ The Joint Replacement Center of Seoul Metropolitan Seonam Hospital, Seoul, Republic of Korea. [推断]
相关性: 该论文为临床对比研究，报告应力遮挡发生率，但未涉及有限元建模或界面力学量化，无法直接用于髋关节植入物有限元分析的边界条件设定。
边界: No finite element modeling, no quantification of stress/strain in Gruen zones, no micromotion analysis with contact/friction modeling, and no patient-specific FE boundary conditions.
动机· 比较超短与常规长度非骨水泥股骨柄的长期临床和放射学结果。
方法· 前瞻性随机对照研究，每组858髋，平均随访16.5年和17.5年。
结果· 超短柄组大腿痛和应力遮挡发生率显著低于常规柄组，临床评分和生存率无差异。
验证· 临床I级证据，通过放射学评估应力遮挡。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare long-term clinical and radiographic outcomes of ultra-short versus conventional length cementless anatomic femoral stems.
Method· A prospective, randomized study involving 858 hips per group with mean follow-up exceeding 16 years.
Result· Ultra-short stems demonstrated significantly lower incidence of thigh pain and stress shielding while maintaining equivalent clinical scores and survival rates.
Validation· Level I clinical therapeutic study with radiographic assessment of stress shielding.

A more defective substrate leads to a less defective passive layer: Enhancing the mechanical strength, corrosion resistance and anti-inflammatory response of the low-modulus Ti-45Nb alloy by grain refinement.

Low Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Peripheral Background only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Nan Hu, Lingxia Xie, Qing Liao, Ang Gao, Yanyan Zheng et al. Acta biomaterialia 2021-05-01 10.1016/j.actbio.2021.02.045
单位: Center for Human Tissues and Organs Degeneration, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shenzhen, China; National Innovation Center for Advanced Medical Devices, She
通讯: Liping Tong @ Center for Human Tissues and Organs Degeneration, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Science  |  Dazhi Yang @ Department of Spinal Surgery, The 6th Affiliated Hospital of Shenzhen University Health Science Center, Shenzhen, China.  |  Huaiyu Wang @ Center for Human Tissues and Organs Degeneration, Shenzhen Institutes of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Science
相关性: 该论文研究了低模量钛合金的力学性能与生物相容性，但与髋关节假体应力遮挡的定量分析无关。
边界: This paper focuses on material characterization and does not include any implant-level finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification in Gruen zones, or micromotion modeling for hip implant stems.
动机· 提高低模量钛合金强度同时保持低弹性模量以缓解应力遮挡。
方法· 通过高压扭转细化晶粒实现强化而不改变β相结构。
结果· 强度提升至658 MPa，弹性模量保持61-72 GPa，耐腐蚀性和抗炎性增强。
验证· 力学测试与体内外生物实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance the mechanical strength of low-modulus Ti-45Nb alloy while preserving its low elastic modulus for stress shielding mitigation.
Method· High-pressure torsion (HPT) was used to refine grain size, achieving grain boundary strengthening without phase transformation.
Result· Tensile strength increased from 370 MPa to 658 MPa, elastic modulus remained low (61-72 GPa), and corrosion resistance and anti-inflammatory response were improved.
Validation· Mechanical testing (tensile, corrosion) and in vitro/in vivo biological assays.

相关性: 该论文为临床回顾性研究，比较两种髋关节假体的临床和影像学结果，包含应力遮挡分级，但未涉及有限元分析或生物力学建模。
边界: This paper reports clinical outcomes without any FEA, contact mechanics, or micromotion simulation; it does not provide biomechanical modeling or validation for hip implant stress shielding.
动机· 比较Tri-Lock骨保留柄与标准Corail柄在全髋关节置换术中的临床和影像学结果
方法· 回顾性分析84例Tri-Lock和84例Corail患者，评估临床评分和X线片应力遮挡分级
结果· Tri-Lock柄大腿痛和应力遮挡发生率低于Corail，但手术时间和功能评分无显著差异
验证· 临床随访平均48个月，通过Kaplan-Meier生存分析比较假体存活率
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare clinical and radiographic outcomes of Tri-Lock bone preservation stem versus conventional Corail stem in primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 84 patients with Tri-Lock and 84 with Corail stems evaluated functional scores (HHS, WOMAC, VAS) and radiographic stress shielding grading.
Result· The Tri-Lock stem showed lower rates of thigh pain and stress shielding, but no significant differences in clinical scores or implant survival at mean 4-year follow-up.
Validation· Clinical follow-up with Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and radiographic assessment.

单位: Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, USA.
通讯: Joaquin Sanchez-Sotelo @ Mayo Clinic, Rochester, Minnesota, USA. [推断]
相关性: 该论文研究肩关节假体而非髋关节，但应力遮挡的影像学评估方法对髋关节研究有参考价值。
边界: This paper studies humeral stress shielding in shoulder arthroplasty, not femoral stem stress shielding in hip implants; no contact mechanics, micromotion, or FEA modeling.
动机· 评估肩关节置换术后肱骨侧应力遮挡的影像学变化。
方法· 对44例TSA术后5年X光片进行灰度值分析和分级。
结果· 中度应力遮挡发生率7%，灰度值下降≥25%对应临床可见的应力遮挡。
验证· 临床影像学观察与计算机灰度分析对比。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify bone adaptive changes and stress shielding after total shoulder arthroplasty with a cementless HA-coated humeral component.
Method· Radiographs at 6 weeks and 5 years postoperatively were graded by three observers and analyzed using photographic software to measure grey value density changes.
Result· Moderate stress shielding occurred in 7% of shoulders, and a grey value decrease of 25% or more corresponded to clinically observed stress shielding.
Validation· Clinical radiographic grading combined with computer-based grey value analysis.

通讯: Zuhailawati Hussain @ Biomaterials Niche Area, School of Materials and Mineral Resources Engineering, Universiti Sains Malaysia, Engineering C
相关性: 该综述讨论了铌合金化钛合金的力学性能和生物相容性，但未涉及股骨柄植入物的应力遮挡量化或有限元分析。
边界: This paper is a materials-focused review on titanium-niobium alloys and does not quantify stress shielding in Gruen zones, report micromotion values, or include any finite element modeling of hip implants.
动机· 低弹性模量钛合金可减少应力遮挡，但需系统综述铌元素的作用。
方法· 综述了不同烧结温度下铌合金化钛合金的力学性能与生物活性。
结果· β型钛铌合金具有低模量和良好生物相容性，是潜在的植入材料。
验证· 无实验验证，为文献综述。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To review the mechanical properties and biocompatibility of titanium-niobium alloys for reducing stress shielding in bone implants.
Method· A literature review summarizing the effects of niobium alloying and sintering temperature on the elastic modulus and bioactivity of titanium alloys.
Result· Beta-type Ti-Nb alloys exhibit low elastic modulus and good biocompatibility, making them promising for implant applications.
Validation· No experimental validation; this is a review paper.

Motivation· To compare the accuracy of analog and computer-based preoperative planning methods for total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Retrospective analysis of patient data comparing predicted component sizes from analog and digital planning.
Result· Computer-based planning showed higher accuracy in predicting component sizes, though analog planning remains viable.
Validation· Clinical retrospective comparison using postoperative implant sizes as ground truth.

动机· 探讨全髋关节置换术后骨盆活动度与脊柱-骨盆参数的关系，预测术后僵硬型骨盆。
方法· 测量78例THA患者术前术后站立和坐位的矢状面脊柱-骨盆参数，分析预测因素。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate spinopelvic alignment changes after total hip arthroplasty and identify preoperative predictors of postoperative pelvic stiffness.
Method· Sagittal spinopelvic parameters were measured in 78 THA patients using EOS imaging in standing and sitting positions before and 3 months after surgery; logistic regression identified predictors.
Result· 17% of patients developed postoperative pelvic stiff type; lower preoperative pelvic and lumbar mobility were significant predictors.
Validation· Clinical imaging measurements and multivariate regression analysis.

动机· 探究髋关节金属植入物电化学腐蚀机制
方法· 在模拟滑液环境中施加微小电振荡，观察CoCrMo合金表面腐蚀
结果· 电振荡可导致金属离子溶出和表面沉积，复现临床失效特征

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the role of electrochemical reactions in the corrosion of metal-on-metal hip implants beyond mechanical wear.
Method· Small electric potential oscillations were applied to CoCrMo alloy specimens in simulated synovial fluid to induce electrochemical reactions.
Result· The oscillations caused direct metal ion dissolution and surface deposition, replicating the composition of wear particles from failed implants.
Validation· Chemical composition of deposited layers was compared to retrieved clinical wear particles.

单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Matsudo City General Hospital, Matsudo City, Japan
通讯: Shuichi Miyamoto @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Matsudo City General Hospital, Matsudo City, Japan
相关性: 该论文关注髋臼侧放射透亮线的临床风险因素，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动等生物力学分析。
边界: This paper focuses on clinical risk factors for radiolucent lines around the acetabular component, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no femoral stem analysis.
动机· 识别初次全髋置换术后髋臼侧放射透亮线的风险因素
方法· 回顾性分析980例IBBC技术髋臼假体，采用单/多变量逻辑回归
结果· 萎缩性骨关节炎和26/28mm股骨头直径增加RLL风险，结构性植骨和真臼位置降低风险
验证· 临床随访10年，以翻修为终点进行Kaplan-Meier生存分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To identify risk factors predictive of radiolucent lines around the acetabular component using the interface bioactive bone cement technique in the first year after primary cemented total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 980 primary cemented THAs was conducted, with univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses to identify risk factors for radiolucent lines based on radiological classification of hip osteoarthritis.
Result· Atrophic osteoarthritis and 26 mm or 28 mm head diameter significantly increased the risk of radiolucent lines, while structural bone graft and location of the hip centre within the true acetabular region were protective.
Validation· Kaplan-Meier survival analysis at ten years with revision for aseptic loosening as endpoint showed 100% survival with RLL and 99.1% without RLL.

边界: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it focuses on assembly forces in the head-neck taper junction.
动机· 量化不同外科医生在软组织影响下的髋关节假体装配力。
方法· 开发带压电传感器的假体和锤子，进行尸体实验和明胶模型体外实验。
结果· 装配力平均2037.2 N，范围822.5-3835.2 N，低于4 kN。
验证· 尸体实验验证体外模型与体内装配力的一致性。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To quantify the assembly forces applied by surgeons during THA head-neck taper junction creation under the influence of soft tissues.
Method· A measuring prosthesis and hammer with piezoelectric sensors were developed; cadaveric in situ experiments and an in vitro gelatin-embedded model were used to measure forces.
Result· Mean assembly force was 2037.2 N ± 724.9 N, ranging from 822.5 N to 3835.2 N, all below the recommended 4 kN threshold.
Validation· Cadaveric experiments validated the in vitro model's ability to replicate in situ assembly forces.

Motivation· This study investigates the effect of zirconium content on crack formation and mechanical properties of IN738LC superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
Method· Two batches of IN738LC powder with different Zr contents (0.024 wt.% and 0.12 wt.%) were processed under identical SLM parameters, and crack density, distribution, formation mechanisms, and tensile properties were characterized.
Result· Higher Zr content increased crack density from 0.15% to 0.87% in XOY plane and reduced ultimate tensile strength from 1113 MPa to 610 MPa; parameter optimization recovered strength by 55.2%.

Motivation· To evaluate the safety of uncemented total hip arthroplasty in elderly patients, challenging current policy recommendations favoring cemented implants.

Validation· Clinical validation using revision rates and patient-reported outcome measures (Oxford Hip Scores) with a mean follow-up of five years.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of MgO doping on the densification and mechanical properties of ZTA composites for total hip arthroplasty.
Method· Two-stage sintering with varying first-stage temperature (1450-1550°C) and MgO content (0-1 vol%) was used to fabricate ZTA samples.
Result· Addition of 0.5 vol% MgO and sintering at T1=1500°C yielded optimal Vickers hardness (19.6 GPa), Young's modulus (408 GPa), and fracture toughness (6.8 MPa·m^1/2).
Validation· Mechanical properties were validated through Vickers hardness, Young's modulus, and fracture toughness measurements.

Motivation· To compare the analgesic efficacy of intrathecal bupivacaine with or without morphine combined with oral multimodal analgesia after total knee and hip arthroscopy.
Method· A randomized controlled trial assigning 153 patients to either intrathecal bupivacaine plus morphine or intrathecal bupivacaine alone, both with oral multimodal analgesia, and recording VAS pain scores and side effects for 24 hours.
Result· No significant difference in pain scores or nausea/vomiting between groups; intrathecal morphine provided no additional analgesic benefit.
Validation· Clinical trial with 153 patients, statistical significance assessed at p<0.05.
